zoe: quick note: our magnet16b-int4-hybrid canary reproduces a deterministic token shift when short role messages cross KV page boundaries. fails ~19k tokens.
theo: only on int4-hybrid? int8/float clean?
zoe: yes, int8/float32 are fine. attaching tiny repro log.

zoe: ```
# replay: ./ci/replay_longchat --model magnet16b-int4-hybrid --seed=11 --window=65536
[init] kv_window=65536 page_size=8192 ropescale=auto
[priming] sys 0..512
[priming] user 513..768
[priming] asst 769..1024
...
[compact] page_flip boundary=8192
[gen] idx=19712 expect="token" got="tok�"  <-- shift
[diag] rot_phase=0.00321 pack_stride=4 base_pos=2147483647
```

rachel: base_pos looks like int32 max. if base_pos is truncated to int32 during compaction we can get wrap-related phase errors.
theo: try forcing base_pos to 64-bit and run with pack_stride=1 to see if it delays/masks the issue.
zoe: did: base_pos64 + pack_stride=1 pushes divergence past 120k tokens. so two contributing factors: base_pos truncation and pack alignment.

infra-bot: ci/canary magnet16b-int4-hybrid: flaky-run detected -> ticket CAN-317500 opened.

rachel: action items:
- zoe: add page-snapshot dump for first/last 8 slots on compaction (ETA 1h)
- theo: run small grid pack_stride={1,2,4} base_pos={int32,int64} ropescale={auto,1.0} (ETA 8h)
- rachel: add per-layer hidden-state cosine diff vs float32 to canary (ETA 24h)

zoe: logging artifacts -> s3://redwood-ml/canaries/3175000000/. marking ML-3921 P1 until root cause isolated. :eyes:
